caseName: Church of Scientology of California v. Wollersheim
caseNameFull: Church of Scientology of California v. Wollersheim

opinions.text:
Ct. App. Cal., 2d App. Dist. Motions of National Association for the Advancement of Colored People and National Council of Churches of Christ in the U. S. A. for leave to file briefs as amici curiae granted. Certiorari denied.

Justice Brennan took no part in the consideration or decision of these motions and this petition.
